title: Cross-Environment Multi-Paradigm Motor Imagery EEG Dataset
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from motor imagery (left- and right-hand) tasks collected in different recording environments. The main dataset covers 84 healthy participants in a shielded laboratory and a simulated hospital environment, and is intended to study how environmental variability affects EEG-based brain-computer interface performance. A small supplementary dataset from 3 participants recorded in a space station environment extends the collection to a non-terrestrial, microgravity setting. Multiple paradigms are included: Graz, SSMVEP-MI, and hybrid video conditions.
methods_description: The main dataset was recorded with a 64-channel EEG system (10-20 layout; 60 channels used) at 1000 Hz raw and 250 Hz processed. Each trial had a 2 s cue period, a 4 s task period, and a 4 s rest period. Paradigms were Graz motor imagery, SSMVEP-MI, and hybrid video conditions. The supplementary space station data were recorded with a 32-channel dry-electrode EEGO system and stored as MATLAB .mat files.
